scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All hard gates pass and the mask review shows coherent moderate tumor-boundary growth. Candidate 01 provides the best balance of local population score and source-like clustering among the alternatives.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The edited tumor regions extend from existing external tumor-stroma boundaries, remain localized and preserve the intervening non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Thirty-seven class-1 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Candidate 01 has source-relative NND 0.955 and Ripley K24 1.032, with a passing local population score.
decisions.coupling: Added nuclei occupy the authorized expanded tumor footprint; boundary binding, seam continuity, quota and compatibility gates pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and native structures outside joint support remain preserved without partial-instance, overlap or containment failure.
decisions.limitations: This is mask-only annotation-conditioned evidence in an uncalibrated research envelope, not generated-H&E or clinical validation.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.
